title: Gotrade Daily: Global Chip Rally & Earnings Night
summary: A global memory and chip rally meets a night of earnings. Watch Micron, Western Digital, Nvidia, Cisco, and Netflix into tonight's US session.
body_markdown:
Not everything moves the same way, though. Cisco closed higher yesterday heading into its earnings, but the early reaction to that report has been cautious despite an upbeat outlook, a reminder that high expectations can trigger profit-taking.


## Tonight's Watchlist


Stock Yesterday's Close What to Watch


**Micron** ([MU](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mu/) ) Yesterday +4.92% NAND supercycle: YMTC passes Kioxia, Korea chip rally. Watch/Hold


**Western Digital** ([WDC](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/wdc/) ) Yesterday +3.69% Same NAND pricing tailwind. Watch


**Nvidia** ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) ) Yesterday +3.03% AI-server demand, Lenovo +19%. Hold


**Cisco** ([CSCO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/csco/) ) Yesterday +2.86% (into earnings) FY27 report landed after close; early reaction has leaned negative. Caution


**Netflix** ([NFLX](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nflx/) ) Yesterday -0.78% News of a new Pershing Square (Ackman) stake. Watch


## Tonight's Catalysts


### The memory and chip rally goes global


The semiconductor rally is now genuinely cross-continental. YMTC overtook Kioxia in NAND shipments for the first time, while Korea's Kospi entered a bull market led by SK Hynix. For US investors, that is a read-through catalyst for **Micron** ([MU](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mu/) ) and **Western Digital** ([WDC](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/wdc/) ), two memory names that already rallied hard yesterday.


### Cisco's FY27 guide gets tested


Cisco closed up 2.86% yesterday heading into its earnings, with a $7.5 billion AI-infrastructure target and FY27 revenue guidance of $72.2 to $73.4 billion. The report landed after the close, and the early reaction has leaned negative despite the strong-sounding guide, a sign that expectations were already high. Watch whether this level finds buyers once the regular session opens.
